description: Known Deltarune mods for the deltaport launcher. 'url' must point to a .zip / .tar.gz / .tar.xz that the launcher can install: either a deltaport mod folder (with files/ and/or patches/), or a modded data.win / game.unx. Add your own entries below - the launcher reads this file when you choose 'Browse known mods'.

mods.name: NXRUNE console borders
mods.description: Restores the original console-style borders on PC. Ships with deltaport (mods/00-nxrune, installed via ./port.sh nxrune); the URL is the upstream source.
